verdict.rationale: Mercury's own docs describe scoped API tokens with fine-grained permissions, in three types (read-only, read-write, and custom), and access can be revoked at any time from the dashboard. This gives an agent least-privilege credentials. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of which permissions or scopes custom tokens can restrict (e.g., per-endpoint or per-account), agent- or MCP-specific credential scoping, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
